capability: Switching sessions recreates project-bound runtime services using the destination session working directory.
pinnedSource: packages/coding-agent/test/suite/agent-session-runtime.test.ts:updates the runtime session cwd on cross-cwd session replacement
setup: Two disposable project directories contain distinct markers, settings and APPEND_SYSTEM.md resources, with project trust varied across two RPC process-test cases: untrusted source to trusted destination, and trusted source to untrusted destination. A separate factory-level test installs the same native provider extension in both projects, then switches from the trusted source to the untrusted target.
expected: Each replacement binds the runtime to the target CWD and trust decision: only trusted project resources/settings are active, shell execution uses the target project prefix when trusted and global settings when untrusted, source-private context does not leak, and the target runtime model catalog includes project providers only for the trusted project.

piSharpExecution.providerCatalogResult: Passed 1/1. The trusted source exposes its project native extension provider/model; after replacement with the untrusted target the provider is removed, the global fixture model resolves, and source/target private prompts stay absent.

comparisonPolicy: Compare effective project identity and the provider-visible tool result, not temporary absolute paths.
limitations: The pinned Pi runtime test directly asserts destination CWD, and pinned source review covers trust-aware settings/resource reload plus provider registration from the target resource loader; a dynamic pinned Pi trust/provider cross-project test was not run.

Other active-run transitions and discovery scan/resource boundaries remain outside this comparison. The final full .NET suite is still required.
